findings.F1: The book fails on its falls and not on its trading costs: its deepest fall is 54.5 % over 556 days in w14–w18, where the book summed −0.73 while holding the coins summed +0.83, and its fees are only 0.002 % to 0.006 % of the book per bar.
findings.F2: The idea is real but far too small to pay: per case over 5 days the unusual move is +0.12 % (strength 0.004, against about 0.05 for confirmed ideas so far), and the total move is +0.07 %. A round trip costs 0.19 %, so the moves are 0.6 and 0.4 times the cost.
findings.F3: The book's gain comes from its longs only. Long bars earn +0.118 % per bar (7497 bars); short bars earn −0.009 % (8190 bars), although the book is short about half the time in every stretch (46 % to 51 %).
findings.F4: In w14–w18 both sides lose, shorts −0.165 % per bar (1609 bars) and longs −0.051 % (1872 bars), while in w1–w13 both earn (+0.068 % and +0.172 %). The book's deepest fall is therefore a period in which the reversed volatility relation did not hold.

findings.F7: The forecast's size is graded. Bars in the top quintile of |forecast| gain +0.120 % per bar, against −0.003 % in the bottom quintile, and shorts in the highest-volatility quintile lose −0.090 % per bar.

ideas.idea: For a coin's 30-day volatility, the higher that signal's predictive power for the coin's 5-day returns over the past 365 days, the lower the same signal's predictive power for that coin's 5-day returns over the following 90 days. This reversal is larger the more the side it points to agrees with the coin's own 28-day return.
ideas.consequence: A trader would take the reversed-volatility bet mainly when it runs with the coin's 4-week trend, and refuse it against the trend, which cuts the losing shorts in rising stretches.
ideas.name: volatility reversal with trend

ideas.idea: The closer a coin's daily close sits to its highest close of the past 90 days, the higher its return over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: A coin trading near its 90-day high is a reason to be long for the next week, and one far below it a reason to refuse a long.
ideas.name: nearness to 90-day high

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's 28-day return, the larger its return over the next 5 days in the same direction.
ideas.consequence: A strong 4-week move is a reason to bet with it for the next week, with a move per case large enough to cover a trade's cost.
ideas.name: four-week momentum continues
